#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum StoreError {
    #[error("database error: {0}")]
    Db(#[from] rusqlite::Error),
    #[error("event {id} not found in room {room}")]
    NotFound { id: EventId, room: RoomId },
    #[error("schema version {found} is newer than supported {max}")]
    SchemaTooNew { found: u32, max: u32 },
}

pub fn load_event(conn: &Connection, room: &RoomId, id: &EventId) -> Result<Event, StoreError> {
    let mut stmt = conn.prepare_cached(
        "SELECT kind, author, body, ts FROM events WHERE room = ?1 AND id = ?2",
    )?;
    stmt.query_row(params![room.as_str(), id.as_str()], |row| {
        Ok(Event {
            id: id.clone(),
            kind: row.get(0)?,
            author: row.get(1)?,
            body: row.get(2)?,
            ts: row.get(3)?,
        })
    })
    .optional()?
    .ok_or_else(|| StoreError::NotFound { id: id.clone(), room: room.clone() })
}
